I actually dragooned Micah because I got tired of being the only one editing 😉 
 I wasn't actually planning to stop volunteering, but then Alexey called me up with a hard job for actual compensation 🙂  <@!301186049323958275> , feel free to ask directly if you want my input on a particular EIP.  I have time to review some, but not to track the incoming  queue.

Especially - if you disagree with an author on whether something should be merged.
